title: Selective Separation of Ammonia from a Ammonia-Hydrogen-Nitrogen Mixture by Pressure Swing Adsorption Method
material: Commercial 3A (K,Na)-A, Z1, 1 mm spheres; initially dried under vacuum at 300 C for one hour, then vacuum-regenerated for 90 minutes after first ammonia adsorption
branch: Repeat adsorption after vacuum regeneration; first-cycle irreversible ammonia chemisorption is excluded
method: Approximate manual reading of clearly separated filled-circle markers; near-axis markers omitted because pressure cannot be resolved
limitations: Single-temperature curve; no adsorption enthalpy inferred. The graph does not resolve the Henry region. Repeat-cycle capacity applies to this regenerated material, not virgin capacity or irreversible acid-site uptake. N2/H2 curves are too close to the baseline to extract reliable nonzero loadings.
